subject: ✅ Office Hours Booked — $instructor_name on $booking_date
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your office hours booking is confirmed. The details are below — please add this to your calendar.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BOOKING DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Booking ID:    $booking_id
Instructor:    $instructor_name ($instructor_id)
Date:          $booking_date  ($day_of_week)
Time:          $start_time – $end_time
Location:      $location
Duration:      $duration_minutes minutes

Your notes for the instructor:
$notes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO PREPARE

  • Write down the specific questions you want to cover — that way the slot is not used purely on context-setting.
  • Bring (or have to hand) the module materials, your latest attempt, and any feedback you have already received.
  • Aim to arrive 5 minutes early; the next student is often booked back-to-back.

Need to cancel? Use the Student Portal — cancelling at least 4 hours ahead frees the slot for someone else. No-shows are recorded on your academic engagement log.

Kind regards,
Academics Office
